mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and we are under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The city has a new toilet rebate program offering 100 dollars to replace older models with high-efficiency ones, plus don't forget the rain barrel rebate program if you are looking to collect water for your garden.
There is a lot going on with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and tomorrow features the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school and the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree.
In police news, on July 26, an officer stopped a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway and the driver was subsequently arrested for an O W I offence.
Enjoy the Raspberry Cheesecake flavor of the day at Culver's, and remember you can also grab a treat from the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 12:30 to 4:30.
